alignments.note: Impersonal anticipatory *It* in a verbless clause, licensed by no morpheme (rule 20).

Finite verb recast as an English infinitive; the lexeme of rash utterance is carried by *rashly*, so the head goes there, *to say* being the verb English supplies for it. Heading on *say* was the competing reading.

`לְ` before the infinitive construct taking the written *to* (rule 52).
